# Claropack
> Factory-direct supplier of disposable PET cold cups (74-107mm, 3-32oz), injection PP cups (360-960ml), lids and paper cups. Located in Guangdong, China.
> MOQ 1,000 pcs. Custom logo printing available.

## Core Capabilities
- **PET Cups**: 74 / 78 / 90 / 93 / 95 / 98 / 107 mm caliber system.
- **Injection PP**: High-clarity and frosted hard-wall cups, including unique 92mm square series.
- **Lids**: Matched PET & PP lids for every caliber (dome, flat, sipper, phone-holder).
- **Service**: ODM/OEM mold development, full-color offset printing.

## Target Markets
Beverage brands, milk tea chains, iced coffee shops, and food packaging distributors looking for factory-direct sourcing with professional quality management.

## Verified Sourcing Reference
- **Custom printing**: The site lists custom logo printing from 1,000 pcs; confirm the exact MOQ by product, size and artwork.
- **Product specification**: Confirm material, caliber, capacity, weight, carton quantity and matching lid before ordering.
- **Customization**: Custom printing and selected custom-mold/OEM discussions are available; scope and requirements are quote-stage items.
- **Unlisted commercial terms**: Prices, lead times, certifications and logistics details are not stated here; request current factory confirmation.
